description:
ASC CLOUD SOLUTIONS is hiring Software QA testers.

Job description:

  • Execute and evaluate manual or automated test cases and report test results
  • Develop and maintain test plans and documentation
  • Provide feedback on the tested product and what should be automated in terms of testing
  • Ensure that validated deliverables meet functional requirements and design specifications
  • Establish the testing method and define the steps to follow for testing
  • Create test cases and scenarios

Looking forward to be working with you!
